name: Shade of Belanaril

abilities.name: Voltaic Overload
abilities.description: The Shade of Belanaril will rear back onto her hind legs and unleashes Voltaic Overload, which inflicts a player with a damage-over-time effect. This effect is displayed as a blue circle at the player's feet. Overload causes the weapon the player is currently holding to deal constant lightning damage. To overcome this mechanic, players must swap to their secondary weapon for at least ten seconds until the effect wears off. Failure to swap weapons (or swapping back before the effect has worn off) is fatal to both the player and nearby allies.

abilities.name: Gryphon Claws
abilities.description: The Shade of Belanaril will swipe her target with her claws when she is grounded.

abilities.name: Gryphon Bleed
abilities.description: This is more of a problem on Veteran difficulty. When the Shade of Belanaril light attacks you with her claws, she will apply a bleed DoT that stacks every time she light attacks you. She shares this ability with the other Gryphon Shades.

abilities.name: Take Flight
abilities.description: As the Shade of Belanaril is preparing to swap into "Flight Phase," a massive AOE will begin to spread on the ground beneath her, knocking back any players standing within. The tell for this ability is when she crouches, giving several preparatory flaps of her wings before swooping upwards.

abilities.name: Gusts of Wind
abilities.description: When Belanaril's Shade is airborne, she will dip down and swoop back up, whipping up small "tornadoes" in her passing. These gusts CC players that they hit.

notes: Having Oakensoul Ring equipped while fighting Shade of Belanaril is almost a death sentence as you cannot swap your weapons if you get targeted by "Voltaic Overload. Though this attack has been updated so Oakensoul Ring users are less likely to get targeted by it, it can still happen and will most likely wipe the group in veteran if it does.
related_quests: Woe of the Welkynars: Help a Gryphon Knight defeat a powerful Sea Sload sorceress and save Cloudrest.
summary: The Shade of Belanaril is a shadowy clone of the Welkynar gryphon Belanaril, created by Z'Maja. It will be summoned after the Shade of Relequen enters combat, who together serve as an optional boss, though defeating them will make the battle with Z'Maja easier.
